sloka: ये गता अभिमुखम् विष्णुम् अक्षरम् पुरुषोत्तमम् ।संपिष्टाः ते तदा युद्धे बिष्णुना प्रभ विष्णुना ॥१-४५-४३॥
transliteration: ye gatā abhimukham viṣṇum akṣaram puruṣottamam ।saṁpiṣṭāḥ te tadā yuddhe biṣṇunā prabha viṣṇunā ॥1-45-43॥

translations.english: In that great and terrible battle between daityas and devatas, Aditi's sons killed Diti's.
